description: Use this when the user wants to find, compare, or buy Pokémon card listings on eBay. Active eBay listings for Pokémon cards with every pokefocus.com/listings filter: card search, cards or set, grade, era, rarity, centering, price, free shipping, listing checks (tags), seller feedback, seller location, and under-market auctions. Each listing has price, shipping, grade or seller condition, its market reference (TCGplayer for raw cards, the eBay sold median for PSA 9 and PSA 10), the card page, and an affiliate buyUrl. A deal label appears only when PokeFocus confirmed the exact card and the Buy It Now total is at least 7% and $0.50 under that reference. Sort by market_gap_percent to list the largest gaps under market first. Results match pokefocus.com/listings for the same filters.

auctionFilter.description: underMarket keeps auctions whose next bid is under market by minDiscountPercent, minProfit, and maxHoursRemaining; it sets listingType=Auction.

cards.description: Only these cards, by PokeFocus card id (`card.id` in listing and card results).

centered.description: Only listings whose front photo measured centeringThreshold or better on every side. Measured from the photo; not a grade.

centeringThreshold.description: Minimum share for every side: 45 means 45/55 or better.

grade.description: Raw (ungraded), any graded slab, PSA 9, or PSA 10.

maxHoursRemaining.description: Under-market auctions: ending within this many hours.

maxPrice.description: Maximum item price in US dollars.

minDiscountPercent.description: Under-market auctions: minimum discount from market, in percent.

minPrice.description: Minimum item price in US dollars.

minProfit.description: Under-market auctions: minimum dollars under market.

q.description: Card name, optionally with the number before the slash.

rarities.description: Only these card rarities, such as Special Illustration Rare.

setId.description: Only cards from this set, by PokeFocus set id (`card.setId` in listing results, `id` in set results).

sort.description: Default: newest for Buy It Now, ending_soon for auctions. price_asc and price_desc sort by item price. market_gap_percent and market_gap_dollars list the largest gaps under market first and include only listings with a confirmed market comparison; best_deal is the same as market_gap_percent, and fixed_opportunity ranks by market gap, then newest. title_asc, title_desc, timing_asc, timing_desc, and recently_synced match the site.

tags.description: Listing checks: hide_over_market (Avoid listings more than 15% above captured market); hide_quantity_based (Hide quantity listings); hide_no_returns (Hide listings with no returns); only_authenticity_guarantee (Only eBay Authenticity Guarantee); hide_seller_description_caution (Hide seller description cautions); hide_missing_back (Require a back photo); hide_missing_corners (Require corner detection); hide_holder_present (Exclude holder or stand photos); only_near_mint_or_better (Raw: Near Mint or better); only_card_condition_excellent (Raw: Lightly Played (Excellent)); only_card_condition_very_good (Raw: Moderately Played (Very Good)); only_card_condition_poor (Raw: Heavily Played (Poor)). The raw condition checks apply with grade=raw.

name: search_listings

affiliateDisclosure.description: The affiliate disclosure that applies to the buyUrl links.

capturedAt.description: When PokeFocus answered; market.asOf is when a price was refreshed.

filters.description: The applied filters in plain language.

buyUrl.description: The eBay listing through the PokeFocus affiliate link.

id.description: PokeFocus card id, the value the `cards` filter takes.

setId.description: PokeFocus set id, the value the `setId` filter takes.

url.description: The PokeFocus card page with market price and history.

deal.description: Present only when PokeFocus confirmed the exact card and printing and the Buy It Now total is at least 7% and $0.50 under market.

lastCheckedAt.description: When PokeFocus last saw the listing active.

market.description: The market reference PokeFocus shows for this listing, or null. label names the source with the price as the site prints it, such as "TCGplayer NM $85.00" or "PSA 10 market $1,499.98"; price is US dollars.

marketTrend.description: 30-day graded market trend points, oldest first, for PSA 9 and PSA 10 listings.

price.description: Item price, or the current bid for an auction, in US dollars.

priceTier.description: How the site colors the price against market: great or good deal, fair, above (high) or well above (veryHigh) market, or none without a trusted reference.

title: Search Pokémon card eBay listings
